scripts.ios:build: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -project Billet.xcodeproj -scheme Billet -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.ios:format: swift format format --in-place --recursive --configuration ../../.swift-format App Widget NotificationService
scripts.ios:format:check: swift format lint --strict --recursive --configuration ../../.swift-format App Widget NotificationService
